page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8269CY processors clocked at 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 52 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include integrated GPUs or local instance storage, relying entirely on remote cloud block storage volumes for persistent data.

Network performance on this instance provides a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for data-intensive communication. The absence of local disk drives requires architectural planning around network-attached storage latency and bandwidth allocation. Cost efficiency is driven by the dense memory-to-vCPU ratio, which reduces the operational footprint for workloads requiring substantial in-memory state without necessitating excessive vCPU overprovisioning.

The ecs.r6.13xlarge is suited for memory-bound enterprise applications. Primary target workloads include enterprise-scale in-memory caching layers such as Redis, large relational database management systems, distributed data processing engines, and extract-transform-load (ETL) pipelines requiring substantial operational memory pools.
